To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis for two popular bilevel optimization algorithms, and (ii) we propose a novel stochastic bilevel optimization algorithm and establish the finite-time convergence rate.

we provide theoretical convergence guarantees for bilevel optimization, which is a powerful tool for meta-learning and hyper-parameter optimization, with the best-known computational complexity in terms of condition number $\kata$ and target accuracy $\epsilon$.

we provide a comprehensive convergence analysis for two deterministic bilevel optimization algorithms respectively based on the AID and ITD methods, and provide a novel algorithm named stochastic BiO, which features sample-efficient hypergradient estimation using efficient Jacobian and Hessian-vector products computations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two aspects of bilevel optimization: algorithm design and theoretical analysis, which can serve as a foundation for the future research in bilevel optimization and its applications.
